title: Nether_wart recipe
description: Allows you to craft your Nether Wart Block back into Nether Wart.
body:
**Description**
This Datapack adds a new crafting recipe which allows you to convert Nether Wart Blocks to Nether Wart itself.                                                                           ![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5effec90509aef83a73e16cd85eecfc3f0c4b6fc.png)

**Installation**
Go to your world folder -> Datapacks -> upload this datapack
If the datapack is not working then do /datapack enable (name of this datapack0
You can find the file name using /datapack list

**Disclaimer** :Do not extract the files!
